entries.text: 07 will wait here until you return.
An older save was kept separately.
The Tower Coil is in the depot's coil crate.
Bring the coil to the tower's pad.
Hold E on the pad to repair the radio tower.
A faint signal. Ping and follow it.
Tilly's parts are in her crashed sled.
Dig up the keepsake and tow it home.
The lift is stuck. Repair its cable.
Park on the lift's platform to ride up to the lab.
A light across the chasm. You can't cross it yet.
Build tower level 2 to power the bay.
Park on the bay's turntable to build.
The tower's next level needs one more part.
07 has the part. Park on the tower's pad to fit it.
The part is in. Now feed the tower its materials.
The Mound Relay is offline. Repair it.
The Shoulder Relay is offline. Repair it.
Repair the offline relays on the way to the Peak.
Link the network to the Peak
Offline. Needs the Tower Coil and materials: see the tower's card.
07 has no tether. Kenji kept a spare at the garage.
Stop and 07 listens: a wreck with something left lights up.
Park here to charge and save.
Brings power home: the lander's windows light and the radio picks up the station.
Powers Kenji's Rover Bay, and the radio stays clear farther out.
Powers the chart in the lab, and the radio is clear across the basin.
Hold to charge, release to leap: 07 jumps over gaps.
A walkman with a tape still inside, labelled in Ro's handwriting: "for the long drive". Side B just says "for when we come home".
Kenji explained every broken part to this duck before fixing it. The duck never said a word, and it was usually right.
Ro's homemade golden record: greetings from four people, one rover and a very proud basil plant, ready for anyone listening.
Ines walked the rim every morning "to check the Moon was still there". The tread is still packed with dust from her favourite ridge.
Theo brewed mint grown in lunar soil in this dented pot. "The first tea on the Moon that tasted like anything," Ro wrote on the lid.
Theo smuggled him aboard as a joke and put him in charge of the seedlings. Nothing was ever stolen on his watch.
Walked the rim at sunrise with Tilly chirping at my shoulder. The Moon is still here, Earth is still up, the coffee is still terrible: all is well. — Ines
Built Bell out of a dead receiver and four camera legs so the station keeps playing while I sleep. She dances. I didn't build that part. — Ro
Night one of Lumen After Dark. Three listeners and a rover who rolls closer when I play the slow ones. Best audience I've ever had. — Ro
First night show. Audience: three crew, one rover, one basil plant. The basil had requests.
Recorded with the mic taped to the airlock. If you hear a thump, that's Kenji.
For the nights Earth looks close enough to walk to. It isn't. I checked.
Bell got home before you. She says the porch light was on.
Bell has picked up a signal. Follow her light.
Bell says: that one's been waiting for you.
Bell says: Ro would have liked that.
Park on the pad to build.
Carries one keepsake home in a rack on 07's back, so the tether stays free.
A wider, brighter light ahead, and sonar pillars stay up longer.
Hold forward on open ground to drive a little faster.

Fixed the old survey rover today, the seventh thing on this week's list, so it's 07 now. I taught its antenna our call sign, three short, one long, and it blinks it at me whenever I walk past. — Kenji
Core sample 41: grey dust, grey dust, one blue pebble. Logged it as "anomalous". Kept it as "mine". — Ines
Named every seedling in tray four; the mint is Gerald. Gerald is the best mint on the Moon, which is a low bar, but he's clearing it. — Theo
Read the storm warning on air tonight, tucked between two slow songs so it wouldn't sound so scary. 07 rolled right up to the speaker and stayed there. — Ro
My call as mission lead: all four of us leave on the morning shuttle. It's the right call, and I've never hated being right so much. — Ines
Hid a spare wheel for 07 under the tarp in the crawler. Next time I'll give it six matching ones, not just patch the odd one out. — Kenji
Ten minutes to pack. I left Moss the watering schedule, and Moss hummed at me as if I'd insulted the tomatoes. — Theo
Last show before the shuttle. I left the radio on for you, 07. Keep it playing, and we'll find you by the music. — Ro
We were coming back, 07. I need you to know we tried. — Ines
Left the last tray by the window. If anything grows, tell me. — Theo
They asked me what to do with the rover, and I said leave it switched on. Don't let anyone retire you, 07. — Kenji
…weather tonight: clear skies over the Sea of Tranquility, as always…
17 MAR 2047 · Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. All four crew landed safely. Program review postponed. Stand by.
2 APR 2047 · Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. A return window is under study. Keep station systems on standby.
11 MAY 2047 · Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. Return window cancelled. Program review continues.
29 SEP 2047 · Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. Program closed. This channel will no longer be monitored. Thank you, Lumen.
07, it's Ro. They say nobody's listening up there. I'm sending this anyway. — Ro, 9 Jun 2048
Ines took a desk job. She still walks round the block every morning to check Earth is still there. — Ro, 14 Jul 2049
Theo says the basil on my windowsill isn't as good as yours was. Don't tell him I agree. — Ro, 2 Aug 2051
Kenji fixed my kettle with a paperclip and a long speech about tolerances. He says hello to the duck. — Ro, 30 Oct 2054
If that old dish ever wakes up, I'll be listening on the station's frequency. You know how to find me: three short, one long. — Ro, 2 Jun 2059
It's been twenty years. I still play the long-drive tape on Sundays. — Ro, 13 Mar 2067
I heard you, 07. I'm still here. — Ro
Told the others. Theo cried, then blamed hay fever. — Ro
Ines went out at midnight to look at the Moon. She says it's still there. — Ro
Kenji asked if you still have the odd wheel. I told him all six match now, and he had to sit down. — Ro
Played your song on my show tonight. Audience: two neighbours and a very old cat. Best audience since you. — Ro
I told Theo about the dome. He's been unbearable all week. — Ro
Weather tonight: rain over Lagos. It's always clear where you are, isn't it? — Ro
Ines's daughter wants to be an astronaut. Ines is pretending to be worried. — Ro
The four of us wrote to the agency together. Don't hold your breath; you don't breathe anyway. — Ro
Kenji's grandson won a rubber duck at the fair. Kenji says it's a sign. — Ro
Goodnight, 07. Keep the radio on. We'll keep ours on too. — Ro
Lumen basin, surveyed on foot. — I. Kalani
Checked: the Moon is still there. — I.
Home. Population: four, one rover, one very proud basil.
Poor thing. It came down still pointing at Earth.
My drill. Core 41 came from here, the blue one.
No entry without Kenji. Kenji: no entry without a helmet.
Brought Theo's seed trays. Landed… firmly.
Where she sulks when I walk too fast.
Ro calls it the little one.
Everything echoes here. Even the static.
Right above Ro's chamber. Of course.
Say something. It says it back, quieter.
Too wide to cross. Kenji says "for now".
Someone always leaves a light on over here.
She comes here to hear herself sing back.
Best acoustics on the Moon. Her words, not mine.
One way only. Don't try it upwards.
The dish. Kenji's job, after the storm.
Too steep for wheels. Atlas parked up here?
They hum in a solar storm. Ro calls it the choir.
Station voice synthesised with a Piper model trained on LibriTTS-R
Ro's voice synthesised with a Piper model trained on Cori Samuel's LibriVox readings

Ro's shelf is filling up. It already sounds like her.
Theo's shelf is filling up. Something on it is almost growing.
Ines's shelf is filling up, everything in neat rows.
Kenji's shelf is filling up. The duck approves.

Two more cells, six in total: enough to reach the far side of the basin.
Cut from wrecks. The Supply Depot has the most.
Power: the tower, relays and kits.
Cut from wrecks. The Drill Rig has the most.
Cut from wrecks. Kestrel-3 has the most.
Electronics: the lab's Reader II, drones, superconductor.
Cut from sealed hulls. Needs the Thermal Cutter.
Melted into glass at the Smelter.
Dug from the orange patches at the basin's old vents.
Drilled from the dark rock bands on the Rim Terraces. Needs the Core Drill.
Drilled in the Shadowed Crater's dark floor. Needs Floodlights to see it.
Drilled on the road to the Peak.
Made at the Smelter from orange beads.
Strong parts: treads, cutter ribs, shelves.
Made at the Smelter from ilmenite.
Keeps hot tools cool: the Thermal Cutter, the Power Core.
Made from water ice at the Ice Still.
Grown from water ice in Moss's biodome.
The great dish, the Star Tracker, the Anchor Line.
Made at Smelter II from rare earths and circuit chips.
07's hold is full. The cut pieces stay on the wreck.
Home storage is full. Build a shelf at a free socket.
Spares for the next rotation. Don't let Ines take the good wire. — Kenji
Lenses off the old relay. Handle them like records. — Ro
Wire for the drill's next season. Labelled, counted, twice. — I. Kalani
For 07, next time it breaks. It will. — Kenji
Seed trays went up top. This is everything else. — Theo
A focusing lens on the beam
The cutter charges faster and cuts 30% quicker, using 15% less battery.
Four more slots in 07's hold, so it carries more home each trip.
Blueprint complete: {0}. Build it in the bay.
